top_signals.title: Why 22 States Are Suing to Block a Federal Demand for 17 Million Truckers’ Records.
top_signals.summary:
A legal battle now underway over the records of America’s truck drivers is being described very differently depending on who is doing the describing. The U.S. Department of Transportation calls it a “radical” effort by state attorneys general to shield dangerous drivers from the law. The states call it an unlawful federal seizure of the […]
